evidence.FACTS: Removed the abstract « grille/méthode » prose, the claim that the NMAX sits in an « étage supérieur » of the local scale, the unconfirmed « dépôt de garantie, kilométrage, assistance, exclusions » as shop facts, and « grilles dégressives ». Prices: no NMAX owner row; only the automatic-scooter category range (150 000–200 000 / 600 000–1 000 000 / 1 200 000–2 000 000 VND) « à titre de repère » with the exact disclaimer next to the table and in the lead, and an explicit statement that the NMAX may fall outside it (consistent with the yamaha/scooters hub). No multiplication, package, discount or conversion. Specs only from Yamaha Motor Vietnam pages seen in search results: standard version 155,1 cm3, ABS front and rear discs, tank 7,1 L, seat 770 mm, 131 kg, storage 24 L, ground clearance 127 mm; TECH MAX 135 kg and 22,3 L; caveat that the latest generation was not in the results and that a rental machine may be older. Licence: Law 36/2024/QH15 A1 up to 125 cm3 / A above, chinhphu portal (seen in search result, consulté 2026-10-30), foreign-licence validity left to /permis-securite/permis/. Deposit, helmets, breakdown contact, early return, extension, availability: phrased as questions or as generic « certains loueurs » practice, never as the shop's policy. NAP and hours as in SEO-FACTS (09:00–21:00 used only in a question about when a rental day ends).
